scope: Two exact parent-observed public popup script URLs; inert research only.

findings.finding: Rows come from viewBag.InitDatas.RowData. Output follows grid row order and assigns SORT_SNO=1,2,... after filtering COL_CD==0. This source does not initialize or cap the number of priority rows at three.
findings.unknown: The observed three-priority initial model is supplied externally; its construction and toolbar receiving logic are not in this module.

findings.finding: getSortCdOption starts with option value 0 and a resource label. It includes columnList entries having realId, excluding tempColumnId, hidden columns and widget.link controls; it deduplicates realId and orders by generated A001/A002... tokens.
findings.unknown: Actual columnList values and resolved resource labels belong to the caller/runtime.

findings.finding: Direction uses button.toggling with btn-asc/btn-desc. Changing writes SORT_DV_CD. Empty or 0 column selection disables the direction cell. Serialization maps UI value B to D and all other values to A.
findings.unknown: The external toggling widget defines its runtime values and rendering; no button click was executed.

findings.finding: For each selected non-0 COL_CD, getSaveSortData counts equal COL_CD values across all grid rows. Any duplicate marks the cells, focuses the first error and returns null. With no duplicates it emits COL_CD,SORT_SNO,TAB_CD,SORT_DV_CD.
findings.unknown: Error popup presentation and grid control behavior are external.

findings.finding: onFooterApply checks canSaveProcess and dispatches normal mode to actionApply. It excludes COL_CD=0 rows and rejects null or an empty result; an empty result marks/focuses the first COL_CD cell. Valid data is sent as {data:sortArray,callback:close}; completeSave restores apply click availability.
findings.unknown: The parent must receive the message and invoke the close callback; parent sorting, comparison, persistence and reset are absent.

findings.finding: Default-settings option exists only outside input-setup and CS modes and opens the same popup with IsFromInputSetupFlag=true. actionSave permits an empty array unless validation returns null. It posts Request:{FormKey:{FORM_TYPE,FORM_SEQ,TAB_CD:[tabCd]},Datas:sortArray} to /SVC/Common/Form/SaveCofsMainsetInSort. Success sends {data:thatFormObject,callback:close}, distinct from normal apply array.
findings.unknown: Server acceptance, storage and the interpretation of empty Datas are unverified. No settings were saved.

findings.finding: onMessageHandler receives a child defaults result at t.data, reopens/submits this popup with RowData=t.data.Datas plus existing form/tab/column context, then invokes t.callback. Close directly calls close(). F8 calls apply only when ecount.global.isDisableAlert() is truthy. No local reset handler is defined.
findings.unknown: This child-default receiving model is not evidence of the parent toolbar/grid receiver. The toolbar sort/reset implementation and ESC behavior remain external.

findings.finding: BarcodeVerification declares external composite widgets searchText, sort and barcode at [1,2019,1,2036], [1,2053,1,2064] and [1,2081,1,2095]. There is no F3 literal or local search/repeat/highlight implementation in this body.
findings.unknown: Find matching, repeat/next behavior, F3 binding, row highlighting, sort receiving model and reset semantics must be researched in the shared widget/composite or parent code. Absence here does not prove absence in ECOUNT.

findings.finding: The verification footer registers F8. _ON_CLICK aggregates entered and original SlipRowData quantities by product code, with description/specification included according to DES_INC/SIZE_INC. It creates mismatches with SQTY and BQTY and opens /ECERP/SVC/Popup/VerificationResult with quantity-format options. If there are no mismatches it alerts MSG10398 and returns false. The empty-product branch marks/focuses a product cell.
findings.unknown: This is quantity verification, not the toolbar find/search implementation. VerificationResult popup rendering and shared button dispatch remain external.

findings.finding: Barcode grid render sets startRowCount=3 only when it is null. A rebuildContent composite is declared with original SlipRowData, form, quantity and column-map context.
findings.unknown: Three default barcode input rows do not establish three sort priorities. Rebuild/reset effects are implemented by an external composite, not locally.
